authority.statement: The notice and locator grant no permission or authority.

boundaries: This notice and locator are communication evidence only and derive no implementation, continuation, acceptance, readiness, admission, promotion, release, Git publication, or external-delivery authority.

No live infrastructure, infrastructure plan or apply, external workload, canary, traffic shift, deployment, rollback, credential use, network effect, or other external effect is authorized or evidenced.
Repository-local synthetic fixtures and validator results cannot be represented as runtime, production, live-environment, deployment, rollback, or protected-effect evidence.
Normal Task Session and Invoke execution-candidate readiness remain unclaimed; lifecycle reconciliation is deferred, not waived.
Profile and tool bindings, ontology and crosswalk admissions, owner bindings, and live subject or environment bindings require their own future owner decisions.
Private DomainSpec material must not cross into public Arcanum, and no public source mutation is part of this handoff.
key_points: The current authorization is limited to the three serial repository-local units and exact validation commands in WP-ORODI-PROTOTYPE-001; implementation and consolidated validation remain parent-owned and pending at notice publication.

The prototype contracts and validator are tool-neutral, non-actuating, and constrained to authority_effect none; they cannot establish live behavior, protected-effect authority, or production readiness.
The current normal ORODI Plan remains non-executing. Candidate-local evidence does not expose a Task Session route or waive later exact-byte Invoke reconciliation.

After local validation, future owners must separately decide profile and tool bindings, ontology and crosswalk admission, and any subject, environment, live workload, infrastructure, canary, deployment, or rollback bindings.

After the exact bytes and consolidated report exist, independently verify this locator and those artifacts, then seek separate authorization before any invoke:refresh reconciliation.
